newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stock markets closed for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Indian stock markets closed for Christmas.

text.p: Indian stock markets were closed for Christmas holidays beginning Wednesday.
The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), the country's premier bourse, will re-open on January 1.
The National Stock Exchange (NSE), however, said it will open for trade on Thursday, close on Friday and re-open on December 31.
On Tuesday, stocks ended mixed with the Christmas mood ahead of the holidays limiting activity in many dealing rooms. The 30-share BSE index dropped 7.84 pts to 3,085.20.
